scene:
The picture has three parts read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines. The parts have no headings.

On the left third, one large index card pinned to a board, the measure record. Its title line at the top reads SETUP EFFORT. Below it, five rows, each a small icon followed by one word: an open book icon with DEFINITION; a filing drawer icon with SOURCE; a single person icon with OWNER; a circular refresh-arrows icon with REFRESH; a dashed fence icon with BOUNDARIES. Nothing else is written on the card.

In the middle third, four identical blank cards standing upright in a row on a table, each with one small icon on the card and, directly under the card, a wide horizontal label plate whose text reads horizontally, left to right, never rotated or vertical: the first card has a ruler icon and is anchored to the table with a small navy anchor, plate ACTUAL 80 HOURS; the second card has a flag icon, plate TARGET 50 HOURS; the third card has a small calculator icon, plate FORECAST €225K A YEAR; the fourth card has three push pins, plate ASSUMPTION. From the forecast card, a thin navy arrow points RIGHT-DOWN toward a small closed piggy bank without any symbols; the arrow is interrupted by an ochre bar, and next to the bar the label NOT CASH YET.

On the right third, three dashboard screens stacked vertically, each with simple bar and line chart shapes and no numbers: the top screen labelled BOARD, the middle screen labelled LEADERSHIP, the bottom screen labelled TEAM. A bold teal thread runs from one bar on the top screen down through the middle screen to one bar on the bottom screen, with a downward arrowhead, labelled TRACES DOWN.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: SETUP EFFORT, DEFINITION, SOURCE, OWNER, REFRESH, BOUNDARIES, ACTUAL 80 HOURS, TARGET 50 HOURS, FORECAST €225K A YEAR, ASSUMPTION, NOT CASH YET, BOARD, LEADERSHIP, TEAM, TRACES DOWN. All text is horizontal. Icons carry no lettering or symbols of their own. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A measure record card for setup effort lists its definition, source, owner, refresh schedule and boundaries; four identical cards are tagged actual 80 hours, target 50 hours, forecast €225,000 a year and assumption, and an interrupted arrow from the forecast to a piggy bank reads not cash yet; three stacked dashboards for the board, leadership and team are joined by a thread that traces down.
caption: Each number held ready on one record, labelled by its kind so a forecast is never read as cash, and traced from the board’s dashboard down to a team’s work.
